bio: Choi 'Zeus' Hyeon-jun is the star top laner for T1, known for his exceptional laning mechanics and ability to dominate in both carry and tank matchups. Since debuting in 2021, Zeus has quickly risen to become one of the best top laners in the world, contributing heavily to T1’s domestic and international success.

Mun 'Oner' Hyeon-jun is the jungler for T1, recognized for his aggressive early-game pathing and ability to secure key objectives. Oner’s synergy with Faker and Zeus has been a cornerstone of T1’s dominance in the LCK.

Lee 'Faker' Sang-hyeok is widely regarded as the greatest League of Legends player of all time. Since debuting with SK Telecom T1 in 2013, Faker has won multiple LCK titles and three World Championships (2013, 2015, 2016). Known for his unmatched versatility, deep champion pool, and clutch performances, Faker has become a global icon in esports.

Lee 'Gumayusi' Min-hyeong is T1’s star AD carry, known for his exceptional mechanical skill and aggressive laning phase. He has been a key factor in T1’s dominance, often leading the team in damage output and clutch late-game performances.

Ryu 'Keria' Min-seok is considered one of the best support players in the world. Known for his incredible playmaking, vision control, and ability to protect his carries, Keria has been instrumental in T1’s success both domestically and internationally.

Kim 'Kiin' Su-hwan is Gen.G’s top laner, renowned for his consistency and ability to play both carry and utility champions at the highest level. A veteran of the LCK, Kiin is known for his laning dominance and teamfight impact.

Han 'Peanut' Wang-ho is one of the most experienced junglers in the LCK, known for his aggressive early-game style and creative pathing. Peanut has played for multiple top teams and remains a key leader for Gen.G.

Jeong 'Chovy' Ji-hoon is Gen.G’s superstar mid laner, famous for his incredible laning phase and mechanical precision. Often leading the league in CS differentials, Chovy is a consistent carry threat in any matchup.

Kim 'Peyz' Jae-hyeon is a young AD carry for Gen.G who has quickly risen to prominence with his sharp mechanics and fearless teamfighting. Despite his age, Peyz has already proven himself on the international stage.
Yoo 'Lehends' Tae-yoon is a versatile support player known for his creative champion pool and ability to adapt to any meta. His unorthodox picks and strong laning make him a unique threat in the LCK.

Hwang 'Kingen' Seong-hoon is Hanwha Life’s top laner and the 2022 Worlds Finals MVP. Known for his clutch performances and ability to step up in high-pressure matches, Kingen is a versatile and reliable player.
